description: Newlines still separate the items of an object constructor nested in a for expression
notes: The grammar lists Newline as a separator between object elements, but the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace, and prose has priority over the grammar, which leaves no newline separator. hashicorp/hcl makes newlines significant inside object constructors and accepts one as a separator, even inside a for expression that ignores newlines: parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(true) for the constructor's items.
